label: Deactivate instance triggers
description: Turn off one instance's own triggers, the way `triggers` says (park, hibernate or wipe), with their runs still going following `running`.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance, by the id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: only
inputs.description: Only these triggers. Every per-instance trigger when not wired.

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.label: Triggers
inputs.description: What happens to the instance's triggers: park keeps what arrives for later, hibernate keeps it for a grace window, wipe drops it.

inputs.name: running
inputs.label: Running work
inputs.description: What happens to the instance's runs still going: wait lets them finish, cancel stops them now. Wipe needs cancel.

inputs.name: graceMinutes
inputs.label: Grace minutes
inputs.description: How long hibernate keeps accepting what arrives. Ignored by park and wipe.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: Off: this run keeps going even when it is one of the runs reached. On: this run ends with them, cancelled.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the triggers are down (under `running: wait`, once they are draining: the runs they fired may still be finishing). Wire it into the `_should_flow` of what must happen after.

then.message: DeactivateInstanceTriggers '{id}' names {names} in `only`, which is no per-instance trigger of this program. Name each the way the program writes it (`inbox`, or `one.inbox` inside an included file).
